question.text: The kinetic energy $\left(\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{k}}\right)$ of a particle moving along $X$-axis varies with its position $(X)$ as shown in the figure. The force acting on the particle at $X=10 \mathrm{~m}$ is

solution.text:
$$
\frac{d k}{d x}=\frac{d\left(\frac{1}{2} m v^2\right)}{d x}=\frac{1}{2} m \not{2} v \frac{d v}{d x}=m a=F
$$
So, Force is slope at $x=10 m \quad F=-\frac{20}{4}=-5 \hat{i}$
